transport.authorization: One Bearer header from the trusted owner host, current registry and Store principal; never an employee/engine credential or payload identity.
transport.request_encoding: strict UTF-8; BOM and UTF-16/32 rejected on these three paths only

required_existing_authority: registered project charter in approved or active state for new writes
current exact project staffing grants for selected E01/E10/E11
existing approved project and Store company budgets
current owner registry+Store principal and exact project scope

identity_and_retry.namespace: Existing settings service:owner-message:+SHA256(canonical([stable principal_id,message_id])); reciprocal conflict checks against existing canonical/legacy communication claims.
identity_and_retry.exact_replay: Same immutable original result under the same stable principal/message ID and normalized complete arguments, even after credential rotation, expiry or supersession, subject to current caller/project access.
identity_and_retry.conflict: Changed action/project/arguments under the same stable principal/message ID are rejected.

canonical.implementation: company.contracts.canonical + SHA-256; frozen C01 codec is unchanged
canonical.record_digest_preimage: For PlanRecord, Authorization and each Receipt: the complete record object excluding its own digest member.
canonical.instruction_digest_preimage: Complete stored legacy PlanningProposal record, including instruction and planning-only flags.
canonical.charter_digest_preimage: Complete immutable stored ProjectSpec registration snapshot; its state remains proposed and is not the current lifecycle.
canonical.staffing_approval_digest_preimage: Complete original stored OwnerApproval for that staffing grant; underlying approval record is not inline, so this digest is a server-owned reference.
canonical.work_order_digest_preimage: work_order.record only: {work_order_id,scope,employee_ids,budget_cents}. The outer authorization digest separately binds approval_id and expiry.

numbers.wire: All new numeric values are finite safe integers; bool/float values rejected. UTC epoch seconds, not JavaScript milliseconds. Cents are integers.
numbers.raw_request_lexemes: Legacy JSON number parsing remains: -0 parses/canonicalizes to integer0; 1.0/1e0 produce floats and fail integer-field checks. NaN/Infinity and duplicate members are rejected.
numbers.staffing_expiry: Floor of the existing grant's finite expiry seconds. Exact original grant contents, including fractional expiry if present, remain bound by approval_digest.
numbers.authorization_expiry: now < expires_at_epoch_seconds <= now+3600, and no later than current owner credential or selected staffing grant expiry.

supplemental_checks: Structural JSON Schema validation does not establish authority, ownership or current eligibility.

New text limits are decoded UTF-8 byte limits: summary2048, step instruction2048, each acceptance check1024 and logical path256; schema maxLength is only a necessary character bound. Reject whitespace-only and NUL text and malformed Unicode.
Enforce complete raw request32768 and actual canonical encoded response262144 byte limits, including all envelopes, escaping, refs and digests.
Recheck independently retained project/instruction/plan/message ID/expiry and all original authorization arguments; response echoes and owner_principal prose never grant scope.
Validate every signed digest/ref/scope and nested instruction/charter/WorkOrder digest; preserve exact historical revision references.

Validate unique step keys, acyclic within-plan dependencies, employee membership, unique repositories and approved relative path boundaries; repository revisions are owner declarations, not verified runtime inputs.
Current auth, charter/staffing basis, policy version, approved project/Store budget and expiry are rechecked atomically before new authorization.
Read eligibility is separate from immutable acceptance. Historical receipts remain retrievable and replayable, with authorization_current false after expiry/supersession/basis invalidation.
Revision invalidation is permitted only before any Task record exists for the linked WorkOrder; otherwise scoped_replanning_unavailable. No project-wide cancellation occurs.

authority.work_order_stored: Only exact owner authorization commits existing OwnerApproval/WorkOrder plus plan binding and immutable receipt together.

proof_scope: Actual local synthetic Store/service verification must be supplied by the reviewed parent source/fixture handoff. This manifest is a file-contract pin, not runtime negotiation, credential grant, production pilot charter, transport activation or full C08/APR/DAG/company acceptance.
